# Lulox (Luciano Oliva Bianco)

> Luciano Oliva Bianco ("Lulox") automates teams' repetitive work with AI agents, and builds custom CRMs and internal tools. For AI agents he prefers Grok, Grok Bot and Hermes. He works remotely from Argentina, in Spanish or English. Site in Spanish at the root and in English under /en.

Automatizo con agentes de IA el trabajo repetitivo de tu equipo, y armo CRMs y sistemas a medida. Si hoy eso lo hacen personas, a mano, una y otra vez, lo pasamos a un flujo que lo hace solo.

## Services

- [Servicios / Services](https://lulox.com.ar/servicios): automation with AI agents (Grok, Grok Bot, Hermes), automations between tools, custom CRM, custom internal tools. English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/services
- [Contratar / Hire](https://lulox.com.ar/contratar): a simple form (name, email, message up to 1000 characters). English: https://lulox.com.ar/en/hire
- How it works: 1) you describe what your team does by hand, 2) a call where the work is estimated, 3) 50% upfront and 50% on delivery. There is no public price list; cost depends on the size of the process and is estimated on the call.

## Examples of what can be automated (examples, not client work)

- Email: sort incoming mail, draft repeated replies, alert when something urgent arrives.
- Moving data: from spreadsheets, forms or email into a CRM, a calendar or a sheet, without copying by hand.
- Receipts, invoices and reports: extract the data from a photo or a file and load it, instead of typing it every time.

## Things he has built

- [Garpen](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos/garpen): personal ERP with contacts (CRM), agenda, finances and a billable timer. Live: https://garpen.lulox.com.ar
- [Tarask](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos/tarask): personal finance with shared households, AI receipts and summaries. Live: https://tarask.lulox.com.ar
- [Malito](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos/malito): self-hosted email inbox with contacts synced to Garpen. Live: https://malito.lulox.com.ar
- [All projects](https://lulox.com.ar/proyectos)
